📺 Ginny & Georgia (2021–Present)

Ginny & Georgia follows Georgia Miller, a charming and resourceful single mother who moves to the picturesque town of Wellsbury, Massachusetts, with her teenage daughter, Ginny, and young son, Austin, hoping to build a better future for her family. While Georgia tries to create a stable and comfortable life, her mysterious past and complicated secrets threaten to destroy everything she has worked for. Meanwhile, Ginny struggles with friendships, romantic relationships, school pressures, and the challenges of growing up while questioning her mother’s decisions. As the family adjusts to their new surroundings, unexpected romances, shocking revelations, and emotional conflicts create tension between mother and daughter. Through dramatic twists, heartfelt moments, and complicated relationships, Ginny & Georgia explores motherhood, identity, friendship, family secrets, love, trauma, and the difficult journey toward finding happiness.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 50–60 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Sarah Lampert

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Ginny & Georgia is an American comedy-drama television series created by Sarah Lampert. The series follows the life of thirty‐one‐year‐old Georgia Miller (portrayed by Brianne Howey) and her teenage children, Ginny (Antonia Gentry) and Austin (Diesel La Torraca), as they relocate to the fictional town of Wellsbury, Massachusetts. The series blends elements of teen drama, family dynamics, mystery, and darker themes. The first season of Ginny & Georgia premiered on Netflix on February 24, 2021, with a second and third season following in January 2023 and June 2025, respectively.
